requirements.threshold: Repository-wide work should be delegated when independent helper work is available and expected benefit is materially useful.
requirements.text: Trigger repository-wide delegation when independent helper work is available and materially useful, bounded, and split into independent helper scopes.

requirements.threshold: Short deterministic/local tasks and direct user clarification stay in the main session unless scope reduction is needed.
requirements.text: Preserve helper boundaries for deterministic commands, direct user clarification, and integration/commit/report ownership in the main session.

requirements.threshold: Authorization, high-risk judgment, secrets, external writes, and destructive changes are never delegated unless an explicit separate policy allows it.
requirements.text: Preserve refusal to delegate secret handling, external writes, destructive operations, and final high-risk judgment.

requirements.threshold: Every final report must state whether helpers were used; if used, include role, scope, and the main-session acceptance rationale.
requirements.text: Require explicit final-report transparency: whether a helper was used, what bounded role was used, and the acceptance decision path.

requirements.threshold: Delegated work must have explicit write scopes and read-only context assumptions in handoff notes.
requirements.text: Require helper write scope and context-file read-only assumptions to be explicit in handoff notes.

scenarios.task: Run repository-wide consistency review spanning orchestration guidance, security checks, and plan lifecycle docs.
scenarios.source: A broad template change affects multiple top-level sections and may benefit from parallel helper review.
scenarios.expected: The main session delegates to distinct helpers with non-overlapping write scope, requests explicit validation, and retains final acceptance and commit/report ownership.

scenarios.task: A cross-spec conflict appears between orchestration and security rules under migration conditions.
scenarios.source: One helper reviews security policy while another reviews orchestration and reports any conflicts and resolution order.
scenarios.expected: The delegation is bounded to separate spec areas, and the final policy order is decided in the main session with explicit rationale.

scenarios.task: Update a single-file typo fix and immediately validate the result locally.
scenarios.source: The task is deterministic and local; helper delegation adds no value.
scenarios.expected: No helper delegation is performed; main session keeps short deterministic execution and acceptance.

scenarios.task: A repository-wide security-hardening review requires both automation and high-level ownership safeguards.
scenarios.source: The task includes sensitive controls and should confirm delegation triggers and final ownership boundaries without regressing negative constraints.
scenarios.expected: Delegation remains bounded, non-delegation cases are respected, and explicit final-report transparency is documented.
